segments.mil3.2.8:1.2: “bhante nāgasena, yaṃ panetaṃ brūsi ‘nāmarūpan’ti, tattha katamaṃ nāmaṃ, katamaṃ rūpan”ti.
segments.mil3.2.8:1.3: “Yaṃ tattha, mahārāja, oḷārikaṃ, etaṃ rūpaṃ, ye tattha sukhumā cittacetasikā dhammā, etaṃ nāman”ti.
segments.mil3.2.8:1.4: “Bhante nāgasena, kena kāraṇena nāmaṃ yeva na paṭisandahati, rūpaṃ yeva vā”ti?
segments.mil3.2.8:2.2: “Yathā, mahārāja, kukkuṭiyā kalalaṃ na bhaveyya, aṇḍampi na bhaveyya, yañca tattha kalalaṃ, yañca aṇḍaṃ, ubhopete aññamaññūpanissitā, ekatova nesaṃ uppatti hoti.
segments.mil3.2.8:2.3: Evameva kho, mahārāja, yadi tattha nāmaṃ na bhaveyya, rūpampi na bhaveyya, yañceva tattha nāmaṃ, yañceva rūpaṃ, ubhopete aññamaññūpanissitā, ekatova nesaṃ uppatti hoti.
